operational_advisories.impact: High — Affects Microsoft Entra ID & SharePoint Online Connector Deployments
operational_advisories.summary: When transitioning from broad federated search permissions (AllSites.Read) to least-privilege site-scoped access, we recommend deploying the SharePoint Data Ingestion Connector with explicit Sites.Selected permissions granted per target site collection. This keeps document indexing scoped strictly to authorized policy libraries without requiring tenant-wide read consent.
